verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official LightSprint CLI. The mention of coding "locally in Claude, remotely via codex" refers to third-party agent tools whose PRs LightSprint tracks, not a LightSprint-provided command-line interface. A CLI is a fair question for this kind of platform, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
